Extract multiple Open Graph tags including type, url, and site_name

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<html><head><meta property=\"og:title\" content=\"Article Title\"><meta property=\"og:type\" content=\"article\"><meta property=\"og:url\" content=\"https://example.com/article\"><meta property=\"og:site_name\" content=\"Example Site\"><meta property=\"og:description\" content=\"An interesting article.\"><meta property=\"og:image\" content=\"https://example.com/article.jpg\"></head><body><article><p>Article content here.</p></article></body></html>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
